name: System Stats
description: CPU, memory and uptime of the machine running OmniCore
complete-description:
How the machine running OmniCore itself is doing: CPU load, memory used, uptime, hostname, and core count. CPU usage is measured properly rather than guessed — two snapshots of cumulative tick counts taken 200ms apart, compared, rather than a single misleading instantaneous read.

Five fields, all reorderable by priority the same way Weather and Disk Space are. No network access at all — everything comes straight from the OS.
